notes:
Real clip (window 1.3-2.3 s of S06.mp4): extreme macro, locked-off, dead-on view of the rear of the car, one round taillight centred at (0.498,0.50): bezel ring 0.527 W x ~0.91 H (lens ~0.47-0.5 W), red core ~0.195 W. The lamp ignites from a dark lens with a faint red core (k=0, core luma ~0.28) to a hot white-orange concentric core inside a glowing red ribbed lens, fully lit by k~12 (core luma 0.28, 0.53, 0.76, 0.86, 0.89 at k=0, 6, 12, 18, 22), then holds; horizontal anamorphic streak through the centre. The housing around it is DARK (luma ~0.10-0.12, bezel ring 0.15-0.19, lens 0.04 -> 0.18). Also visible: a second dark round lamp of the same size cropped at the left edge (its right edge at ~0.116 W, y 0.1-0.9 H, i.e. only ~1.235 lamp diameters from the main lamp), the curved rounded-rectangle housing edge arcing round the right of the lamp (x~0.85 W) with a dark groove just outside it and a horizontal slot at y~0.56-0.58 H from x~0.88 W to the edge. Camera: perfectly level/perpendicular, no pan/tilt, practically static (~1% push-in).
Previs (UNCHANGED vs v1, params identical): lens 85 mm, camera level at z=0.74 on the lamp axis x=0, 1.04 m behind the lamp (-> 1.028 m, 1.2% push-in), looking +Y; car_pos (-0.56,2.275) yaw 0 puts the car's right taillight on the axis, rear toward the lens. Measured on the final frames: outer disc centre (0.499,0.499), 0.519 W x 0.922 H (real bezel 0.527 W x 0.91 H), core 0.19 W; camera level, no pan, dolly +1.2% - everything within ~2% of frame size of the real lamp. Checked with a 5-time side-by-side sheet.
WHAT I TRIED FOR THE VERIFIER ISSUES (nothing is fixable with existing params): the ignition is hard-wired in RECIPES['S06'] ('taillight': 'ignite' = linear-in-linear-light colour ramp dim 0.10 -> lit over the WHOLE shot, f0 -> f1, same colour on outer disc and core, ring constant dark) and is not exposed to the shot's previs block (only lens_mm/speed/handheld/car_ease are merged into the recipe; car_ease only affects car_path); panel colour 'body' and the lamp colours are fixed, and Workbench shading multiplies panel and lamp discs by the same factor (they are parallel), so yaw/camera moves cannot change the crossing. Measured luma (r<0.07 W core / ring / outer disc / panel): k=0 0.05/0.21/0.05/0.45, k=2 0.22/0.21/0.22/0.45, k=6 0.36/.../0.36, k=10 0.45/0.21/0.45/0.45 (outer disc = panel, outline vanishes), k=12 0.49, k=22 0.65 (still ramping at the end of the shot; real is lit by k~12). Frame-diff of the first three steps 5.2x/3.0x/2.3x the median (real 1.0-1.3x flat). (e) top strip: dark strip 4.4% H over x 0-0.56 W + trapezoid at x~0.69 W because the frame top at the panel plane (z~0.873) is above the rear-panel top edge (z=0.86) and the lamp (r=0.118) is almost as tall as the 0.12 m of panel above its centre. Measured camera-only fixes: lens 85->87/89/90/92 mm shrinks the strip 4.4%->3.1/2.1/1.7/0.7% H but grows the lamp to 0.941/0.962/0.969/0.997 H (real 0.91; at 92 mm it touches the frame edges); lowering the camera 0.025 m with a level aim removes it but moves the lamp 6% H up (centre y 0.44) and crops it at the top; the verifier's suggested lower+aim-at-lamp variant makes it worse. I kept lens 85 (best lamp size/centre match) and accept the strip.
BUILDER REQUESTS: (1) ignition params in the shot's previs block (S06 recipe is hard-wired): 'ignite_s' (ramp duration from the shot start, here 0.5 s = lit at k~12, then hold), 'ignite_from' (start level: the real core is already a dim red at k=0, luma ~0.13-0.28, previs starts black 0.05) and an ease/ramp in display (sRGB) space instead of linear light, so the first steps are not 5.2x/3.0x/2.3x the median. Target previs core luma ~0.19, 0.36, 0.52, 0.58, 0.60 at k=0, 6, 12, 18, 22 (previs lit colour saturates at luma ~0.65). (2) keep the lamp outline readable: do not ramp the OUTER disc (lens/bezel) through the panel grey (0.45) - ramp only the core (and optionally the ring), keep the outer disc a constant dark (~0.10-0.20 display) so the dark lens/bezel contrast holds the whole shot; or add a macro panel colour option: real housing is much darker than the previs (0.10-0.12 vs 0.45), e.g. panel ~0.2 display. (3) neighbour lamp + housing for the macro: second dark round lamp, same size as the main one, centre-to-centre 0.651 W = 1.235 diameters = ~0.29 m (builder TAIL_X spacing is 1.12 m, so it is out of frame) - e.g. a 'lamp_gap' key = 0.29, so its disc is cropped by the left frame edge (right edge at 0.116 W); a rounded-rectangle light bezel plate round the lamp whose right edge arcs at x~0.85 W (top edge leaves the frame at x~0.62 W), a dark groove just outside it and a horizontal slot at y~0.56-0.58 H from x~0.88 W to the right edge. (4) rear panel/deck: make the macro rear panel top >= z 0.92 (or cull back faces; the dark strip is probably the back face of the rear deck z 0.86 -> 0.90 plus the wing strut stub at z 0.87) so only panel is visible above the lamp.
